nom: Origins Drink Up Intensive Overnight Hydrating Mask

avis.texte: This used to be my favorite product. I loved the way it made my skin feel and look. It was extremely moisturizing without being too oily. It felt so soothing and creamy against my skin. Unfortunately, with the new packaging indeed came a new formula. I'm very disappointed. It may not be because the new formula is supremely inferior it's just that the old formula had a beautiful love affair with my skin. I don't like it but definitely would say try it and see for yourself. Especially if you're new to the product. You may love it. Again, I hate it *BIG tears*

I've been using this face mask for about 6 years and it has worked great. But, ever since they rebranded and changed the bottle, the lid has broken on me. This has happened with 3 different bottles 3 separate times, and I've had to waste product. They definitely made the bottle cheaper and I cant depend on the quality anymore. Unfortunately I will not be using this brand again.

Good effect but extreemly intense fragrance. I am not sensitive to smells, but I have to use it at night before i go to bed so i sleep through the smell and even then i find myself avoiding using it. Might throw it away too late to return.
I love this because all I have to do is wash my face and use this instead of the other steps I used to do. Great product and it saves time.

avis.titre: Fell in love with this product years ago.... Stayed in love
avis.texte: I don't worry about using to much and I never wipe off excess. My skin absorbs it while I sleep and in the morning, my face feels and looks glowy, hydrated and plump. I use prescription Vitamin A, I'm 55 and I have psoriasis.

avis.titre: I always try to buy this product and take it wherever I trav
avis.texte: I use this at night because I live in a desert area and my skin is naturally dry as well. This really has saved my face from wrinkles. It is so obvious when I don't use this for a couple days how dry my skin becomes. Please don't eliminate this!! It's sad to find Plantscription products and Dr Weil products eliminated from your stock.

avis.titre: New look is bland, boring and indistinct from others
avis.texte: Why does every product look the same? The new tube matte look is so generic. The Drink Up tube looks exactly like the Checks and Balances Polishing Face Scrub as well as the Frothy Face Wash. Everything product used to have a distinct, stylish color and look. For how much the consumers pay for the product, one needs to be able to easily discerned one product from another.

avis.titre: Great overnight moisture mask but strong scent
avis.texte: Soooo hydrating for those days my skin is thirsty. I have extreemly dry skin and this WORKS! Im not sure if they add fragrance or if kts the smell lf the ingredients, but the smell is very very strong and lingers for hours. Good thing its an overnight mask. If they can remake it without fragrance this would be the perfect mask.

Absolute favorite! I wake up with moisturized, smoothed skin every morning. Most moisturizers feel good but dont carry their benefits through the night. This is excellent fir dry, aging skin. The smell also doesn't trigger my migraines which js another plus.

I got this and a sample and i am condisering buying the full product. It certainly does what it promises! I put this mask on like once a month when my skin is feeling dry and i wake up to noticibly refreshed and plump skin. I read a fre reviews that say they use it as moisturizer - honestly, im not sure how that works, as it leaves a sort of soapy residue on the skin. A couple of times this mask gave me a pimple or two over night but i still think the hydration it provided was well worth it.

By far my favorite skincare product. I don't use it how the directions say to use it, I use it as a daily moisturizer. Skin feels amazing all day and I no longer get acne. The scent is very strong, but I have gotten used to it. I love this product!

This stuff is my holy grail but not for the reason it's advertised. It's still a great mask and I do use it as that and it's fantastic. But this stuff when you have a sunburn on your face is incredible. I'm prone to bad burns and if I get one, I use this daily as a targeted treatment on it and it helps me sooooo much. Recently had a blistering sun burn on my forehead and I used this and it healed so well and so fast. Also works great on normal burns but I will never be without this in the summertime especially. Obsessed. I use it with my am/pm skincare and as needed during the day without wiping off when I'm using it as aftersun. It's never too heavy or greasy. Love love love.

avis.titre: Beware, I Wanted to like this but :/
avis.texte: My skin is pretty good when I try out new products, but this one.. in the span of like 5 days every night, it has caused some breakouts. On the right side of my face, chin area. Its very unusual for me to have any breakouts so it was definitely this product. Scary that it was super quick to break me out :/

I have struggled with intense stress with having 3 kids (twin toddlers) and school, and an ended an extremely unhealthy relationship. I developed eczema like dry patches all over my forehead and between my eyebrows going down to the bridge of my nose. I started using this because i felt ive used every intense hydrating or nourishing mositurizer, oil cleanser, hydrating cleanser, even applying skin oil on my face and nothing has reduced the texture and dry patches on my forehead and between my eyebrows significantly after 4 days. I know it says night mask but i also put some during the day as well.
Been using this product for years. Very happy with the product itself, just disappointed the size has been reduced but the price remained the same.
I'm absolutely sold on my Drink Up Intensive. It definitely nourishes your skin; I could tell the difference in a few weeks.
the absolute best nourishing mask. can be used instead of moisturizer at night. love it!
Ppl keep saying its sticky or greasy. No one mentions that its supposed to be tissued off. Which i dont understsnd. I keave it on and rinse in the AM. The print is super tiny on the packaging.

Tried to use this product on dry skin on my cheeks and nose. Within about 30 seconds of applying the product, my skin began to burn and turn red. Just disappointed that this product further irritated and dried out my skin.
Nourishing mask. Applied at night. Can not be washed off. Very pleasant smell. The texture is delicate. Moisturizes the skin well. The packaging is beautiful, it looks like something organic

I have overall been happy with it for some years having quite dry skin in the winter. It is very thick, smooth and moisturizing, but will leave the skin tacky for a few hours. I found it to be too much to use right before bed as it would kinda stick to my pillowcase as I am a side-sleeper. It delivers what it promises, but it will be too much for some people. Also, I have found that it can sting a bit when applying it some nights. Some ingredients in there are a bit irritating to my skin (maybe the essential oils), and I make sure to avoid using it if my skin barrier is compromised. The scent is nice but a bit strong.
Origins overnight night mask is too greasy, leaves stains on the pillow. Very poor absorption. Wouldn't buy it again. Disappointed with the texture, but the scent is pleasant.

I honestly didnt read the ingredients before i bought this. I really like Origins eye cream. So i wanted to try this. I bought this and their ultra moisturizer. I was really disappointed when i read the ingredients and it said "peg" on it….. thought this was a clean brand. And it burns my skin….
We moved to a dryer climate this year and I actually will use this mask as a moisturizer after I shower and my face soaks it up. Never heavy and mositurizes perfectly. 💫
Wished I used this earlier for my dry skin during the winter. I always get dry skin around my T-zone and this instantly moisturized my face and I had no dry flakes the next day.

I have combination skin. I apply a semi thick layer before bed. Wait 10 mins ans gebtly tissue off the excess. This has SHRUNK my pores and gives you a supple glow. I received this from my boyfriend as a gift. He, by accident, found the homy grail of skin care.

I get terribly dry skin in the winter that leaves flaky patches all ivee my face. I've purchased several expensive lotions recently but nothing has got rod of the flaking. I decided to try this while it was half off, due to the reviews, and im ao glad i did! This is not a daily moisturizer! This is technically an overnight mask, and that's exactly how im using it. Used it for 2 nights in a row and my skin is glowing! The ONLY negative I can say is that this product does have a scent. Its not bad at all, but I like to use fragrance free stuff.

Compelled to write a review for my other dry/sensitive skin peeps. I started using this after college (~7 years ago I think?) and have kept coming back to it since. My skin gets SO terribly dry in the winter and is also super sensitive. I've tried lots and lots of products over the years but this is the only one I've found that combats the dryness while not irritating my face. It's definitely thick and maybe a little sticky but I apply it morning and night in the winter without much issue. Big recommend from me.
I want to like this product because of what good quality it is. It's ultra hydrating, soothing and so smooth. But it's grossly sticky. I wish there was a way for it to not to stick.

Every freakin winter my skin decides to go to war with me like its my fault seasons exist and I get these horrible overly dry, flaky patches around my nose and chin but this product is a bad boy and knocks that nonesense off within 1-2 days. Only problem is I can only use at night because it is a thick formula that makes me look greasy after a few hours and im naturally oily like a frying pan. But who cares its bed time. By the time I wake up the dry skin ate all product up and I just gently take a face razor to any left over flakes. It use to make me so insecure and I couldnt even wear makeup over the dryness so every winter I atleast have a bottle in my bathroom or a mini in my purse

On my lazy days (2 days a week), I allow myself a simple skin care routine before bed. This product contains avocado butter as shown on the green packaging, Hyaluronic acid is the main ingredient for hydration. Buttery creamy texture, sweet scent like fresh fruit. After all the cleansing steps, I apply this super rich cream, which actually melts quickly with body temperature, making it easy to apply. 1 product and you call it a day. I also applied it to my hands and knuckles and it's work amazing. You will wake up with fully hydrated skin. You can feel the softness to the touch. The thick cream is probably the only downside, it sticks to my pillow.

avis.titre: This mask single-handedly saved my skin barrier.
avis.texte: I was having super dry, flaky skin and NOTHING was working to fix it. On the suggestion of a friend I started using the Drink Up Intensive mask. She gave me one of the travel sized tubes of it. After 2 nights, I'd ordered 2 full-sized tubes for myself. After 2 weeks, I'd gone back in and put it on subscription. My skin isn't dry AT ALL anymore, no flakiness, and I've now been able to see results from my OTHER products and actives because my moisture barrier isn't totally shot. I cover two finger-lengths with the mask to apply--this is enough that my skin absorbs MOST of it, but there's still a thin barrier layer on top to protect from dry air at night. Using this amount every night still lets the tube last about 4-5 weeks. This stuff is life-changing.

Today, I'm excited to share my thoughts on the Origins Drink Up Intensive Overnight Hydrating Mask. I was fortunate enough to try a sample, and here's my honest review based on my own experiences. First impressions: The packaging is clean and eco-friendly, which aligns perfectly with Origins' commitment to natural ingredients. Texture & Application: The mask has a creamy texture that feels luxurious on the skin. Applying it was a breeze, and a little goes a long way, making the sample size surprisingly generous. Overnight Experience: I applied the mask before bedtime, and the first thing I noticed was its delightful apricot scent – it's like a mini spa treatment in a jar. The mask absorbed quickly without any greasiness, which was a huge plus. Results: The next morning, I was greeted with noticeably softer and more hydrated skin. My complexion looked refreshed and rejuvenated. Dry patches that I often struggle with were noticeably improved. Key Ingredients: The mask contains avocado and apricot kernel oil, which are known for their nourishing and hydrating properties. I could genuinely feel the difference in the morning. Final Thoughts: Origins Drink Up Intensive Overnight Hydrating Mask lives up to its reputation. It's a fantastic option for anyone dealing with dry or dehydrated skin. Plus, it's cruelty-free and free from parabens, sulfates, and phthalates, which aligns with my commitment to clean beauty. I would highly recommend this product, and I'll definitely be adding i

avis.titre: I've been trying this mask this is my 3rd time now
avis.texte: I say this a lot I have dry skin and it's 90 degrees out here and for some reason my skin has been extremely dry and flaky these past weeks and going to bed with this mask works wonders for me and I wake up to nice plump hydrated skin. I feel it working but in a luxurious way. I overall love this brand and every product I've tried from them has done it's thing.

I have beeen using this moisturizer mask for about 2 years now and it has been the best thing that has happened for my face: keeps my skin hydrated and plump, I do get a little irritated at times but it goes away & it keeps my skin clear
DO NOT purchase if you're sensitive to smells. This product has a VERY strong scent and nearly gave me a headache. Avoid if you are looking for an unscented mask.

I love love love Origins and have been using many of your products for years. I even used the make up line before it was discontinued. Within 60 seconds of using a sample i received, I could feel my skin becoming irritated. It left my cheeks quite red. Not sure what happened. I do not have sensitive skin and have never had a reaction before. I washed it off and applied one of your strums I use and your nitamins moisturizer like I usually do. Still feel tingly and cheeks still red. Hope it clears up before morning!

This overnight mask makes my skin feel so hydrated. I have pretty dry skin, and if you do too, I would 100% recommend this to you. It feels so nice on the skin as well, it's super cooling and relaxing, especially after a hot shower.

avis.titre: I use it every day and night!!
avis.texte: I know it's an overnight mask, but I use this as my daily moisturizer when my skin is dry (winter months) and my skin has never looked better!!! I normally have dry skin and it never feels oily with this!

I want to start off by saying I absolutely love this brand ! But I do suffer from dry skin. I gave this mask a couple of go's and unfortunately it wasn't for me. I did follow instructions but maybe I'm looking for something MORE intensive. Nothing goes to waste at my home so it's my daily night cream for my hands !
I love drink up overnight mask so much! Just this mask helps me with dryness 😍 and I haven't irritation after using. In the morning my skin is so smooth! And I love smell with mango and avocado

avis.titre: All-Purpose Awesomeness: Mask, Hand Cream, & Moisturizer
avis.texte: I use this mask after the Original Skin mask once a week or so, and the combo makes my skin glow and feel soft and smooth---my husband even noticed a difference! Not only is this a great face mask (and it smells SO good) but it's the best hand cream I've found! I cook a lot and have a bunch of animals, so I wash my hands about 1000 times a day. I use a little of this mask on my hands before bedtime as needed and it keeps them soft and smooth. No more dry and chapped hands for me! Oh, and I also use a very thin layer as my daily moisturizer on the coldest winter days. Makes a big difference!

avis.titre: Do not use if you have acne prone skin !!!
avis.texte: This mask is very very bad for acne prone skin, gave me whiteheads all over !!!
I use this mask as a "pick me up" or just to restore my skin. I get dry spots sometimes and this mask saves me every-time.

I have fair dry skin that in the winter can end up peeling. I was hoping this overnight mask would provide the deep hydration my skin needs. At first I tried it on its own to make sure my sensitive skin could tolerate the ingredients. No negative reactions, but i woke up with tight dry skin. The next night I added a hydrating serum underneath. It helped a little. The following night I added my regular moisturizer and the serum to the mask and results were better, but not worth the trouble. I'm glad I purchased an Origins sampler kit instead of buying the full-size.

Good things come to those who wait? Yeh I'm not so sure about that anymore. The small GWP tube I had of this has been in the group of samples I've been trying to work through since mid last year. Now that I finally get round to using it (Tuesday night and Thursday night gone) I've come out in acne along my lower cheeks/jawline, more so the right side. The hydrating effect is there but not as good as other overnight masks, for example PC Hydrating Recovery Mask is a lot better at putting moisture back into my skin. However what PC doesn't do is brighten. Origins really gives you such a nice glow, like when you've used a good Vitamin C serum, and is kind of what I expected from seeing all the brightening ingredients in it (and why I was so impatient to use it lol). Both times the glow was pretty much gone by the morning and in its place was acne! A couple of bumps the first time, which I was hoping were just coincidental and then plenty more the 2nd time around, despite the 48 hour gap in between use. Had it not been for the breakout I would have happily used up the sample tube and gone and bought the full size. -> My 'Ulta Beauty Top 7 must-have list' (My 7 favorite beauty products of all time, focusing mainly on my purchases at Ulta) < - < 1. Hair Loss Treatment: Divine Herbal Hair Oil < 2. Eye Cream: Clinique All about eyes < 3. Lip Gloss: Clarins Lip Comfort Oil < 4. Makeup Remover: Lancome Bi Facil < 5. Pigmentation + Anti-Aging Serum: Divine Herbal Facial Treatment Serum

I just used this last night and I woke up very hydrated! Just a little bit thicker than my other moisturizers. Felt soothing on my face. My skin is a little oily, so I was worried that I'd wake up greasy, but nope! My skin felt perfect & soft! Not dry or oily! Not sticky, just smooth! No irritation at all and no oily stains on my pillowcase! Just feel hydrated!!

My face had a bad reaction. I had redness, rashes and a bit of swelling. I've been using this product for years! So for me to have a reaction shook me! Why? Why would you change the ingredients. I'm the old formula the most prominent ingredients and the first Ingredients were Aqua, rose water, myrtle water, orange water, chamomile, glycerin, ethyl alcohol… Now the new formula reads aqua, glycerin, ethyl alcohol, then all the flower/fruit waters So basically you put more alcohols and minimize the natural ingredients I was upset that the size went from 3.4 to 2.5 yet the price was more. I was willing to pay it if the ingredients were the same. Bad move, Origins!
This overnight mask is great, My skin is very hydrated, soft and supple

This is my favorite face mask ever. I have oily, dry, and sensitive skin, and I live in a dry climate too, so I need something that does a good job at oil control but is also not too light, because light moisturizers tend to make my skin peel. Ever since I started using this mask my face become much smoother. No more excessive oil at the end of the day, and no more peeling skin. Never had rash or allergy from it either (I'm pretty prone to it). And what's even better is that I think I'm getting fewer acnes than before. It feels comfortable, smells good, and the truth is I've almost been using it as a daily moisturizer because I don't have to rinse it off. So convenient!

I am OBSSESED! I have extremely dry skin (excema, flakes all of it) and I have been on the hunt for a really good moisturizer I have tried everything even the most expensive ones. This by far is the best my skin has ever felt. I wake up it feels like baby skin. My skin is so soft it absorbs fast and I have no irritation and my flakes and excema are gone!

avis.titre: Origins Drink Up Intensive Overnight Mask
avis.texte: Thanks to Bzzagent, I was gifted this Origins Drink Up Intensive Overnight Hydrating Mask in exchange for my honest review. This is a mask I can see myself using for years to come and I actually have already been using for years as it is! I use it in addition to my normal moisturizer, although I am seeing most people substitute it in place of. On nights I use this mask, I go about my normal skin routine as usual, and then immediately before bed, I mean literally right before I get into the bed, I apply this mask, which is typically about an hour or 2 after I've applied my usual moisturizer, that way it's had time to absorb and the mask can do its job. I wake up with the most rejuvenated, supple, and soft skin. Dullness and flaky dry skin are eliminated and my skin is bright, and ready for the day.

My skin in the winter is dry, dull, textured, and irritated. I've found this to be one of the few things that really helps. It soothes my skin, keeps it deeply hydrated, and smooths out rough dry spots. I use it at night and sleep with it on and wake up with smooth and soft skin

avis.titre: Great staple I used in the last - now, it's not worth it!
avis.texte: I purchased this in a trio many years ago with the rose clay retexturizjng face mask and the charcoal face wash. The rose clay mask and this product were staples in my routine. I was actually shocked at how healthy my skin looked after using this overnight mask and applied about a pea-sized amount nightly before going to sleep. The prices have gone up and the amount of product has gone down. I'm still looking for a replacement and won't repurchase this.
I know this is not a night cream, but I use it almost every night especially when the weather is cold and dry.

A lot of people complain about the texture of this product and it's important to remember that it's a mask so it won't feel like a regular moisturizer. You can use it as regular moisturizer but it is sort of slightly sticky. The texture doesn't bother me. I use retinol products and this moisturizer is one of the only things that does a really good job of helping me retain moisture over the right now. And it smells amazing!
Felt great on my skin, but the smell was so strong and off-putting that I had to wash it off before going to bed. On a positive note, it did not irritate my very sensitive skin.

This mask is great for when your skin is feeling really parched. I have oily skin but I also can get dry skin in the colder seasons. This mask really helps hydrate my skin and leave it with a nice glow in the morning. I do get a few tiny pimples in n my face if I use this too many nights in a row but nothing that would make me think this product is no good.

I know it says to use this a couple of nights a week, but I use this almost every night as my night cream and I love it! My skin is not really dry or oily or sensitive, so I guess I'm in that sweat spot, skin wise. But I am in my late 40's and my skin doesn't look it's age yet so I'm trying to keep my skin looking as young as possible for as long as possible without fillers or cosmetic procedures. I apply it thinly after cleansing and toning and wash it off in the morning. I've not had any problems with residue on my pillowcases either. But definitely avoid the eye area as I've gotten it too close and it burns a bit. Otherwise, I love it!

I had a travel size in a gift pack that lasted forever & I lived it, so I got the full size! The price seems steep, but a little of this product goes such a long way, and I don't think this should be used nightly anyways. I have very sensitive & oily skin, but I have no issues with this & if anything it helps my skin be a little less oily bc it's so moisturizing! I tend to use if after The Ordinary red peel & it's so calming and cool feeling on the face. Love this product so much, smell is only really a factor when you're applying. And the greasy look can be avoided by not using too much product, but also it's not a genuine negative as this product is best for overnight use.

I use this as a moisturizer since my face gets dry and starts flaking and I have never had any problems since then. I would use this at night and then use another one in the morning if you don't need that much hydration. This is amazing!

This stuff just okay on my face, but it is AMAZING on my hands and feet. I'd ask to have a body sized tube, but would be afraid they would change the formula for a "body lotion". It's perfect the way it is. It only takes a small amount and my hands and feet feel so much better. I even like it better on my hands than my old favorite from Hey Honey. It's pretty pricey for a hand lotion though ;)

avis.titre: Origins Drink Up Intensive | Overnight Hydrating Mask
avis.texte: Mega hydrating! Especially for dry skin girlies like me. If you're looking for a nice overnight mask, this may be for you. I was told by my dermatologist to add in 1-2 face masks a week into my routine and what better way to incorporate a product that does double the work in hydrating your skin overnight. ✨ After cleansing your face apply this mask and let the magic work while you get that precious beauty sleep you oh, so deserve! Don't be surprised when you wake up the next morning with plumped skin with a side of glow! ✨ DISCLAIMER : The scent isn't terrible, but if you're not a fan of Avocado this may not be for you!
There are a lot of great products, but I do like the texture of this one the best
I don't care for the scent at all. It does moisture very well though

I got this mask last winter to treat my dry skin and it worked! I use this twice or thrice a week. This is my 2nd tube. It is an overnight mask but I usually use it before makeup. I put a thick layer 20-30 min before makeup and keep it for 5-10 min and then wipe it off. If I need it overnight then I put a thin layer like we put moisturizer. Sometimes I use it on other dry areas like elbows, ankles etc. Let me know how you like this product 🙂
This stuff smells amazing. It is a bit on the thick side but it does not break me out or make me overly oily like some others I have tried. I got it as a gift but plan to continue to buy it.

i got a sample bottle in a kit for my wedding day and i got hooked immediately. i have textured skin and this really hydrated my skin WITHOUT causing my pores to clog and giving me breakouts. a little goes a long way, worth every penny.
I put some on my face and then went to bed and when i woke up i was in red hives and my face was all swollen. it has been been like this for over 24 hours and has gotten more swollen.
I have the driest, flaky skin, especially in the winter. This stuff + the ordinary hyalauranic acid or however you spell it completely changed my skin.

avis.titre: Excellent for dry and/or sensitive skin
avis.texte: I have a lot of allergies to products, but fortunately, 98% of Origins is safe for my face. Add to that the fact that everything smells wonderful, and you have a match made in heaven, or, on my face, whichever.
I love this stuff! I use it every night and it feels so good on the skin.
I have lost count of how many bottles of this overnight Moisturizer I have purchased over the years. It solved my dry skin problems. All of them. I even use it on my elbows.
Use it just in urgent case when my skin is burned or super dry! Cool to use it instead of night moisturiser and wash your face in the morning. You'll see how much it changed the skin
This overnight hydrating mask definitely works well for me. I love how it helps on my skin. Recommend to anyone who has oily skin

I love a good overnight mask like this one. It's not messy and so easy to use. You apply it like any other face cream and can go to bed right away. This is such a great product for anyone, but especially when you're feeling lazy or tired and don't want to stay up longer to wait to take up a sheet mask. The product leaves your skin feeling hydrated in the morning and washes right off with just water and without additional face wash.
obsessed with what this does for my skin. super hydrating i can always tell a difference.

I'm not sure why it called mask but it's nothing like mask! It's just a lotion for dry skin. I don't like how this product stays on your face, and it won't go away until you wash it off, and I have a very dry skin. Glue like feeling, gross👎
You only need a little bit and it doesn't clog my pores. I have been using this for years off and on and I see a huge difference in my skin when I use this.
Didn't help my skin. I've been using it for a month and my skin hasn't gotten any better.
I'm in love with the smell and feel of it. It's a little bit of luxury and I use it every night in the winter. A little goes a long way!

Origins has great masks and this is no different. Put on a thick layer (not too thick) before bedtime and let it soak in all night. Just dab it off in the morning with water and start your morning routine. This tube will last a year when used alternating other masks. You can use it for shorter than overnight or a daily moisturizer. This is my second or third package.
This stuff is AMAZING!! Perfect for my parched and dehydrated skin. Plus, the smell is lovely. Use this nightly with no breakouts or milia production.
Hello - this is my second time using this mask Night 1 and Night 4. My skin is puffing and I have white spots on my face. What am I doing wrong :( My face is red.

I can't say I'm the biggest fan of this. It smells a bit off to me and it leaves my skin feeling sticky. While it does hydrate, I feel there are much better options. Origins used to have a drink up mask with apricot in it, and that one was much better in my opinion. I will finish the sample I got but I wouldn't repurchase this.
can't sleep without it! hydrates my dry face the perfect amount. not too heavy but totally refreshing. will rebuy over and over again. smells great too

avis.titre: My face is so dewy now!
avis.texte: I love this product so much. Drink Up Intensive Overnight Hydrating Mask has been amazing for my very acne prone, product sensitive, aging skin (43). This is the second Autumn I've used the mask…. Getting ahead of winter dryness (I'll use it Autumn- early Spring) usually as directed/ twice a week, but as the heater starts to be on and when winter dryness arrives I'll start using the mask numerous times a week. I've been using it around my eyes almost every night again & the level of repair & hydration is amazingly noticeable. My skin heals so quickly, like overnight, when I have this mask on…. My night Regimen is Plantscription face wash then this Hydrating mask & the avocado lip mask & that's it! The smell is great, the consistency feels so great on my face & neck & it doesn't mess up my silk pillowcase as I sleep. I'd definitely recommend this mask to anyone looking to increase hydration & get ahead of/ maintain moisture & dewiness in the cooler months.

I so wanted to love this product. I did my nighttime routine, then put on this mask. I was immediately struck by how fragranced it was, but decided to give it a chance, thinking perhaps it would dissipate. No such luck - this was citrus to the max, and I had to wash it off. I give this two stars because while it is hydrating, it doesn't do much good when I can't stand to wear it. I'm okay with fragrance in a wash-off product, but not this level in an overnight mask. If ever Origins makes a fragrance-free version, I'd be happy to buy it.

I've never had a reaction like this. My skin can usually handle trying out new products and I wouldn't say it's super sensitive. But this mask has made my face and neck itch for the last 48 hours and counting. I do not recommend this product!! I believe it is the limonene ingredient. Topically, limonene can cause sensitivity and is best avoided. Like most volatile fragrance components, limonene also has strong antioxidant benefits and has also been shown to calm skin; however, when exposed to air these highly volatile antioxidant compounds oxidize and become capable of sensitizing skin. This is certainly what it did and I cannot believe Origins hasn't recalled this producr and taken it off the shelves!! If I could give this 0 stars I would. I am itching as I type this. Not cool, Origins.
the fragrance is good. however, the texture is very sticky. I don't feel like it absorbs at all to my skin.

avis.auteur: More for dry skin not for comb.
avis.titre: Not for oily skin or combination better for dry skin
avis.texte: I have combination skin (oily and dry) and at first I loved this product it smells rlly good and I think it kinda brightens your skin BUT it is not for combination skin it broke out my face worse and honestly I'm not even sure if it keeps your skin moisturize Bc I would wake up and my face was very oily I recommend more for dry skin

I have a combination skin type (ie dry and oily). As of recent years, I tend to be more acne prone. I received this product as a sample when I was dabbling with ipsy.. I absolutely loved it. I'm not consistent when it comes to a skin care routine. I work twelve hours nights and I have four children. As much as I would love to get a routine down pat, there are days/nights when it becomes difficult. This is why I fell in love with this product. I would wash my face and slap this on right before I went to sleep. It didn't matter if I was able to achieve eight or more hours of sleep or a two hour power nap. When I washed it off, it carried the same results. The dry areas I had prior to applying, would feel soft and hydrated. The more oily areas didn't seem as greasy. I bought a full size bottle and I use it often. My face feels very plump and appears more bright than prior. It also helps at keeping the acne at bay. Annndddd, it smells absolutely amazing!!!

avis.titre: New formula and size for same price
avis.texte: First off this used to be bigger. So they made it smaller and are still charging the same price. They must have changed the formula too because this now makes me break out like crazy. I used to love this stuff and it was great for dry skin. Now i get a face full of pimples every time i use this. I guess I'll use it as a very expensive body lotion because it does smell really good. I won't repurchase again.

I ordered this item for the first time after hearing a rave review. But I received a funky looking product with a label and package skewed to one side and has no indication of being a "new" product. I contacted customer services and asked for a refund.

I LOVE this stuff. I got it in a FabFitFun box a few years back, and I didn;t read the directions to only use twice a week. I used it nightly. I have had beautiful, soft, supple skin since I have started using this. I do use it nightly after I wash and mist my face. I only use a very small amount. I let it absorb and go to bed. I don't think that it is a bad thing that I am using it nightly?? I am going to look for another product made by them to see if there is a daily use cream. It has a very light fragrance, a wonderful consistency, and doesn't stain my pillowcase. Will never go without!!
Though I have combo, leaning somewhat oily, I love this. I've used it for years and it really does a great job of hydrating my skin. I also really enjoy the scent. Highly recommend.

I don't understand how a product can fail this miserably. I have sensitive skin. For this reason, I can't use heavily fragranced products as I've learned from using this mask a grand total of 2 times before it murked my skin. This mess of a mask somehow manages to both be heavily fragranced and yet smell like the garbage water from a camping dumpster?? I legitimately do not understand this. Is it the avocado? Is it something else? Why??? Just don't put fragrance in it if it's bad for certain people's skin and still manages to smell horrible???

avis.titre: I will not buy any of your product
avis.texte: The mask I bought was produced in 2018 and expired in August of this year. I bought 3 of them and can only use one of them. The rest is for health and can only be thrown away. I have always heard people say that the production date of your product is not very good, but I didn't expect to encounter it. Too bad shopping experience！！！
This is amazing ! My skin goes to bed feeling & looking like a glazed donut !!!! Wakes up feeling refreshed & feeling smooth! Acne prone skin.......

Why am I paying the same amount of money for LESS product than the original which was way better? Your old formula used to be 3.4 fl oz and now it's 2.5 oz. If I had noticed that online I would never have purchased this. Will never purchase this again. I will never trust a company that cheats customers in this way.

This product made my face swell up. Not only does Origins test on animals, but they have toxic ingredients they do not mention. I am not allergic to anything I've heard on their ingredients list. However, my eyes were nearly shut and my face was dry, cracked and painful.

avis.titre: If you're looking for a hydrating mask, buy this.
avis.texte: Not only is this super hydrating but it also smells like delicious apricots. I think the smell sold me. Nonetheless, this works! It goes on like a moisturizer (creamy and smooth) and definitely does the job of hydrating :)
This overnight mask is super hydrating and smells amazing. The apricot scent made me fall in love. I put it on at night after my skincare and it goes on like a moisturizer, creamy and smooth.

I have been a faithful to origins products for a very long time, i shied away for a short while to try other brands and products and seem to always come back. I love this mask it is a must use in my night regimen. I'm 47 and my fave needs hydration, this mask does it for me. I wake up with hydrated skin every time! The avocado ingredient has removed the redness I used to have around my nose and sometimes my chin area. Forever product on my list and the price is amazing for the result I get.
Its so smooth, my dry skin feels so good, and hydrated with this mask. Highly recommended. The fragance it's good.. I think it's going to be my favorite for a relaxing night

I bought this based on the good reviews and appealing ingredients... but most of all I was enticed by "drink up" in the name. I wanted some thing that absorbed and hydrated my skin over night. This has sat right on top of my skin each time I've used it and I wake up with it still there and sticky. I thought it was odd that the instructions say "tissue off"... why would I want to tissue off a hydrating sleep mask? Isn't that a waste of product? And defeat the purpose? I wanted it to work it's magic overnight, as advertised, but instead I've gone to sleep and woken up with a sticky face. And no notable benefits. Bummer.

I received this to review, and this is how I do stars: 1. Smell/Texture 2. Price 3. Applications 4. Feel 5. Results So I am giving this a two star for smell and texture, and application… This smells wonderful, the texture is smooth, and it was easy application… HOWEVER, The feel was sticky after I put it on… It did not soak into my skin… It burned my face each time I tried… And the next day when I would get in the shower my face was slimy… for all of this I think the price is too steep…. As for the results, my face is drier than it was when I started… It has never been this flaky… Pictures to prove

Lately my face has been really dry, the cold wind and air has really sucked out the moisturize from my face. I've been using this product for years now and it always works for me. At night I apply a thin layer and in the morning my face feels incredible. I usually apply this for about 4-5 nights in a row then slowly transition to about every other day then twice a week. It smells amazing and this has a creamy texture. Once applied on my face it kinda feels velvety. It has drastically made my dry patches fade away.
the texture and its smell make the sensation in your pil more pleasant, however we do not leave aside its natural ingredients
I got a free product from BzzAgent. This was a really good mask. I have dry skin, and it didn't stick to any patches, it didn't irritate my skin or anything.

Its very very light. I left it on overnight like it said but I feel like I might have put it on to lightly cuz it did and felt like it wasn't on anymore. Maybe rubbed off on my pillow I'm not sure but didn't notice it. When I ruined my face it felt nice n soft
Nice mask.hydrate my skin forcthis kind of weather. Me and my daughter use this.
Love this mask. It's so lovely. It's slightly cooling and skin was so hydrated.

I really like the feel of the product and how moisturized my face felt. I wish the labeling was bigger and the instructions were clearer. I did stop using however due to it causing my face to have a breakout, if that wouldn't have happened I would've kept using
Very hydrating, love how fresh and supple my face feels after using it.
I enjoy using this mask as part of my nightly routine now. It goes in smooth, leaving my skin soft and it does not have any strong odor or perfume. By morning, my skin is still soft and moisturized.

I was a little intimidated by this product because I had never tried an overnight treatment before. I thought that it would be sticky and get all over my pillow or sheets however, I was so wrong. This mask you do twice a week is so great for the skin especially in the winter when you're dealing with dry skin. I have dry patches on my face and since testing this out, I actually see an improvement. My face is smooth and this mask really smells amazing. The only thing I was confused about is in the directions it says to tissue off however, I didn't think this was necessary for me.

I received this product at the perfect time. I noticed my skin particularly my chin and forehead had become so dry it felt almost scaly. I've used this every night and in the morning in place of my usual moisturizer & I have to say I no longer have dry patches on my face! It works exactly like you would expect which is awesome. It's fairly affordable too as moisture masks go that truly work.
I received this product from Bzzagent, complimentary, in exchange for my honest review. This was such a rejuvenating, soothing mask. Left my skin bright, smooth, and baby soft. Highly recommend.

This overnight mask has some amazing ingredients, avocado, orange, I mean really good ingredients for the skin. The mask has a nice thick, but easily warmed to a more liquidy consistency and absorbs into the skin quickly, but leaves the skin with a moisturizing layer you can feel. It has a citrusy sent, to me it smells like peaches. If scent is a concern, skip this item, but if scent is not an issue, I highly recommend! My skin loved it!

I have tried my hardest to like this product, as I LOVE Origins skin care line. However, the smell of this is awful, and I couldn't make it work. I spent multiple nights trying to sleep with this awful smelling face mask on, before I had to go wash my face. Aside from the smell, the face mask is creamy and hydrating, and I do feel like my skin got some benefit out of it, just not the full benefit of it. I really liked the whipped texture of it, and how smoothly it melted down into the skin.
This mask is perfect for hydration I love using it overnight makes my skin feel amazing and healthy
I really liked it over the last few days, I've noticed I've become a bit more dewy & u absolutely love it. I'm going to continue using this product and probably purchase it at the store!
This mask is so hydrating it feels great on my face I can feel the hydration if that makes any sense but also smells great

My skin is so dry throughout the year and during harsh freezing windy weather it feels like my skin is getting ruined daily! I feel like this product is meant just for me, easy to apply and just sleep. I was worried that the mask would transfer to my pillows as I'm a stomach sleeper but found that if I waited 20-30 minutes before falling asleep that it dries enough not to make a mess. It's so easy to wake up and wash your skin without having the chapped flaky skin I normally wake up after a cold night. Definitely has helped protect my skin and keep it hydrated.
This product is amazing! My face feels so soft and hydrated. It has helped a lot, especially in this cold weather.
This is one of the best masks I've ever used. The Glacier Water is perfect for calming the skin and hydrating the skin. My face felt so smooth after removing the mask.

This mask is nice and hydrating as part of a nightly routine. The only thing I didn't love was the strong scent, it smells good but I just try not to put too many things on my face with that much scent. It's also not very expensive and is a 'clean' product!

First of all, I love anything Origins. Their products are so amazing. I use their energizing serum. I cleansed my face. Then I applied this mask. The consistency was great and fragrance pleasant. In the morning, my skin looked moisturized and radiant. This will definitely became part of my skincare regimen for sure.

Loved this hydrating overnight mask! I have dry skin all year round but in the winter it's way worse. I used this a couple of nights in a row and I saw a difference within 3 days. No oily or greasy feeling either. Light refreshing smell.
Lightweight but it works! you can feel the difference before you even go to sleep ! I love it ! I will be purchasing again!

I love the scent of this, mix of kiwi and another fruit maybe apricots. You can certainly smell it strongly but I enjoy that. The scent fades once the product sinks in. Now that's where I remove one star, it takes a while for it to sink in if I use it over a moisturizer as a sleeping mask. I get the best results using it that way, but I do have to wait a bit after my routine to go to bed or I get some transfer to my pillowcase. But the next day, my dry skin feels and looks plumped up and there isn't any winter flaky skin in sight. If you use it without a moisturizer under it it does thinking more quickly but I think the effects are somewhat blunted. All in all I really like this and will definitely continue to have it as a staple in my routine. I received this product as a free sample from BzzAgent

Normally I'm not a huge fan of overnight masks because I do not like the feeling of them on my face while I sleep. However, this one was much more like a lotion. It was light and not sticky. I liked it very much and it had a good scent. Didn't notice any dramatic differences to my face, but it was a nice little self care.
I did not like this product at all. It was very sticky when I applied it. It never really absorbed into my skin either. I would never recommend this product to anyone.
Love the feel of this product. It's very much like a lotion in consistency. It dries very quickly on the skin but leaves an intense hydrating feeling.

I have fallen in love with the Origins overnight hydrating mask!!!! A little goes a long way over your clean face before bed. My skin felt amazing the next day! I just took a face wipe to remove the excess still remaining!!!! It worked so well and after several uses never broke me out or caused any breakouts! I would definitely recommend this product!!!!

This mask is perfect for my dry skin specially now in the winter months. I use this mask 2 to 3 times a week depending on what my skin needs. I don't use any other products when i use this mask only my cleanser and toner and i substitute my normal moisturizer for this. When I wake up my skin is so soft and supple after using this mask, its incredible. Has a very light scent it's pleasant and refreshing. Definitely recommend to anyone who needs a good boost of hydration. This product was gifted to me by bzzagent complementary in exchange for my honest opinion. Will definitely purchase once I finish this mask its totally worth splurging on it.

avis.titre: Moist Surge in a Polar Vortex
avis.texte: This mask has felt like a life savior throughout this polar vortex in the Midwest. This was just the cool surge of moisture that I needed to get me through the last couple of days. I also have extremely sensitive skin and haven't noticed any breakouts or sensitivity even during a fibromyalgia flare up

Wow! Loved this product so much! From the pleasant and slightly citrusy scent to the gel-like creaminess, this Overnight Hydrating Mask really delivers! It's so easy to apply and I love that I can leave it on all night for added moisture while I'm sleeping. Especially now in the winter when my room is so dry - this mask has been keeping my skin looking and feeling super hydrated and healthy over the past week. In the morning, my skin is dewy, plump and looks radiant! Oh, and no residue left on my pillow while I'm sleeping. All in all - a fantastic product that I highly recommend.

I want to start this off by saying i can't believe how amazing this product smells, OMG. If i could eat it, i might LOL j/k. This gave my skin the boost it needed this winter and left my skin feeling baby soft each morning. It is a great product that i am extremely glad i was able to try.
Amazing product to wakeup very hydrated! I used to use it after my skincare and it is working beautifully!

I received this product in exchange to an honest review and I think it's pretty good. It hasn't changed my skin completely, but it does make my skin feel softer. I love the smell and texture of the product and I'll definitely keep using it.
Super hydrating overnight mask has a sweet fragrance light yellow color and thick texture. Skin feels soft and smooth the next morning.
I really enjoyed the way it made my face feel after I remove it and I really enjoyed the smelled of it so much

I love this mask. It smells very fruity— not an avocado scent but it smells really great. It's also really hydrating— a little goes a long way. I even put it on during the day and it still works. My face has been extremely dry lately and I have a lot of dry patches. Only one other moisturizer works and this mask. It's perfect for winter.
It has a light avocado scent which I kind of don't mind but it is a bit strange haha. Overall the product is easy to apply and does moisturize overnight. I did like it

Left my skin hydrated and soft feelings. It actually made me feel refreshed for the rest of the day because I applied it in the morning and didn't feel like if it stripped my skin and made it dry. Love it.

The first time I used it I was surprised by the texture. It was like a moisturizer and the smell was great. That night I had a lot of fine bump on my face and the morning after using the bumps were little to none. I have t gotten a bad reaction because I have sensitive skin so I hope it stays that way.
This mask really gave some great hydration! I was super impressed by how much more plump my skin was!

This is an excellent overnight leave-on mask. It smells amazing and feels creamy and silky on the skin. You don't need to use much of this at all. I noticed that the next morning my skin is very hydrated but not oily.

The packaging states that you can put this on clean skin, but I get dry skin in the winter so I didn't see this being enough, but I tried it that way and sure enough, this was not hydrating enough at all for me. A few nights later I tried it on top of my normal skincare routine before bed and I woke up with skin that wasn't exactly "hydrated" but it wasn't dry how it usually is. The product itself is a nice cream that goes on smoothly and isn't sticky like other overnight masks I have tried. I liked that it didn't leave my skin even more dry or cause me to break out but unfortunately this is not something I would purchase.

I thought that this Origins mask is pretty nice. The scent is very rich, as if I was in a Origins store. You don't need a lot to cover your face and its not so sticky or oily to rub in. I also like that it can be used on knees, elbows and hands as lotion. I would have given it 5 stars if it didn't smell so much. Not that the smell is bad, it's just a lot.

I cannot say enough!! I love the way my skin feels the next morning! I love the smell, and how you can totally be lazy with this mask!! You don't have to wash it off. It moisturizers without making me break out. Smells great, goes on light, skin feels baby soft. And I have always been a fan of the origin brand as they use good ingredients in al of their products.

I am completely obsessed with this overnight face mask! I LOVE the way it smells. It makes my dry skin feel super hydrated and smooth. Its very lightweight and it feels like it really sinks into the skin unlike other overnight masks that can feel like they're sitting on the top lawyer only. This stuff really works!

I tried The DRINK UP™ INTENSIVE Overnight Hydrating Mask With Avocado & Glacier Water and it was great for my skin. I used it after my nightly skincare routine a couple times a week and it helped my skin lock in moisture. The smell isn't offensive and it isn't terribly greasy. It is a little heavy, but it is a mask meant to be worn overnight. Overall, I would recommend this mask to a person with dry skin that wants to add some moisture to their skin.

It smells delicious but don't love its texture, it feels like you put on a sticky mixture that will never wash off. The next day your skin feels soft and smooth that I loved. I don't love the texture but I do love the end result.

I've really enjoyed using this mask. I love that I can apply and keep moving. No returning 15 or 30 minutes to remove. The texture is creamy yet light and provides instant moisture after cleansing. It even smells like avocado, but it's light and doesn't linger.

avis.titre: Super moisturizing and love the scent!
avis.texte: This sleeping mask is incredible. I love the scent of it and how moisturizing it is for my skin and love to put it on before bed. The packaging is also pretty.

Wow! This is such a great night moisturizer. After the first night I used it I could tell a difference. My skin looks way more hydrated and has a glow to it. It does have a scent to it though. So if you are not a fan of fragrant skincare this may not be for you.

Origins DRINK UP™ INTENSIVE Overnight Hydrating Mask With Avocado & Glacier Water is working wonders for my skin! I have to admit that I was a little hesitant, after reading reviews, to use this product. I saw that some had allergic reactions to this product, I have sensitive skin, but I had no problems whatsoever, after using at least twice a week for about a month now! I love that the mask is so light, yet so creamy and moisturizing! I love that unlike other products, the scent is truly light and fresh! After applying, It is so light that I couldn't even tell I had it on! This is a life saver in the winter months! It keeps me hydrated in the cold and dry air in the midwest, where I live! A little definitely goes a long way and easy to apply without being greasy! I will definitely buy this in the future and recommend it to all my friends and family!
This over night mask it's very thick which it's good for the days my skin it's very dry. Works so we el over night it's very good

I really enjoyed the origins drink up intensive overnight mask! It is SUPER hydrating, and the smell is amazing. It might be a little too heavy so just be mindful of the amount you use. A dime size goes a long way.
Left my skin feeling refreshed and moisturized! Overall easy to use and have had zero problems. Also calmed my redness and oily t-zone area. Very happy with this product
This product was very thick at first when you rub it in but after it sets in it leaves your face moisturized.
Tried it on myself and my husband and our skin felt so hydrated and soft for the rest of the day and the smell is amazing

I have dry/combo skin so I enjoyed this hydrating mask. I was kind of confused with the instructions because I wasn't sure if I was supposed to leave it on or take it off right after. I really liked the way it felt on my skin/

Now that it's getting colder where I live it means most nights I sleep with the heater on, which has certainly dried out my skin. I noticed that in the mornings after applying this my skin looks nice and plump, and feels incredibly soft. I only need a little bit because it spreads very easily. The formula looks thick, but it actually goes on very slippery and thin almost like an oil. I have also been applying a tiny bit to my hands since all this handwashing has really dried them out, and I've noticed that my hands in the morning are much softer! It does have a very strong mango scent, so I'm not sure that this would be good for anyone with super sensitive skin. I have not broken out from this product, and I even also found that this is very nice as a final seal after I finish applying all my acne products. No irritation, very lovely texture, and it doesn't feel greasy. In the mornings it was pretty much all gone, I'm guessing it had sunken into my skin; there was no residue left on my pillows. Overall, I do like this product but just be aware that it is very scented and also, I don't think if you have super dry skin this will be enough on its own.

My skin felt sooo plump & healthy just after one use. This wouldn't be something I need to use daily but maybe a couple times a week because I live in a humid climate. It improved my dry spots immediately & left me with a nice healthy glow.
Love this mask! Really helps clear out impurities and smells divine.
This product did not come with very thorough instructions. I also did not like the sticky feeling it left on my face.

I have very dry skin and WOW! This mask definitely did the trick. I used it on my elbows, my hands, and my legs and woke up with buttery smooth skin. Plus the smell is so fresh and mild which is very important to me.

I used this after a flight when my skin was angry and dry, and my skin the next morning felt incredibly hydrated and refreshed. I used it a few more times after that and have found that I love it for those winter days when a regular moisturizer doesn't offer the same kind of hydration!
I have a face that is extremely dry and this mask hydrates it at the moment I put it on. When I wake up in the morning my face feels and looks great. I highly recommend if you have a dry face.

avis.titre: I will buy this product again
avis.texte: I use this product as directed and it was great. It really moisturize my skin.

At first i wanted to say i hated this product because my face was so so sticky but over time my face got less sticky and much softer . My skin feels so soft and it did not irritate my sensitive acne prone skin, so i love it ! . This mask is super thick so a little goes a long way and i learned that the hard way, i squirted out what seemed like a small amount and it was far to much which made it take longer to absorb . I am loving how soft my face feels and how it did not break me out. This product is awesome!

I am obsessed with the Origins Drink UP Intensive Overnight Hydrating Mask with Avocado & Glacier Water!! It comes in a very decent amount of product so it will last you for a long time. You do not need to use a ton of this product to see the difference. I apply this to my face every night before I get ready to go to bed. It smells so good and feels sooooo moisturizing and hydrating when I am rubbing it into my skin. I was shocked at how smooth and porcelain like my skin looked and felt after applying this product. I use it every single night and will continue to!! It is a lifesaver especially in these cold winter months. This is an amazing night time mask and I highly recommend it. You will not regret it. Your skin will thank you!
Great moisturizing mask.I applied it at night and left my face very nice and smooth.I'll repurchase.

I'm super impressed with how hydrating this product is. Living up north in a very cold and dry climate in the winter, I need as much extra hydration as I can get. This overnight mask is super hydrating and calming for the skin. My skin can be sensitive and this product has not cause any irritation so far.

What a great product this is! I am so happy to have found it! My skin is super dry and this was a life saver for me. I applied the mask before bedtime and the next morning my skin so silky smooth and very soft. My skin was rehydrated and replenished. The product smells so good and natural and the quality is superb. I felt like I was getting a mask at the spa. It feels good on your skin and feels cool when you apply it. I have pretty sensitive skin, and this didn't irritate my skin at all. I will definitely by using this more than twice a week because my skin is in dire need of extra hydration, and my regular face cream just doesn't cut it.

avis.titre: Perfect for those who have combination type of skin
avis.texte: First time trying this Origins DRINK UP™ INTENSIVE Overnight Hydrating Mask With Avocado & Glacier Water and I've been using this for a week now and so far I don't have any issues or something negative to say about this product. I love the scent and my skin feels so soft the next day. I have a combination type of skin it works for me! I've been using this 2-3 times a week and so far I am happy with the result. Especially right now that my skin tends to get dry because of the season.

Not too thick and not too thin of a consistency and sits well as the final layer of my skincare. The next morning my skin felt more hydrated than it usually did. I love it! If you're sensitive to fragrance you may want a different mask. Otherwise this is the perfect sleeping mask for me.
I really love this product, it is so easy to use, my skin is so hydrated and soft.

avis.titre: Origins drink it up overnight mask
avis.texte: I was excited to try this product sense I have seen polarizing reviews for this -so I was curious . It has hyaluronic acid , avocado butter and many other good oils . Smells light (like the flower and fruit extracts in the ingredients , not synthetic) and very rich and creamy . I woke up feeling more moisturized than if I just used my regular moisturizer and my skin was plumped up from the hyaluronic acid . Very nice overnight mask for dry skin . I am guessing the people that didn't like the mask had skin on the oilier side or younger skin because I enjoyed this mask .

I love origins so I was so excited to receive this product. It has an interesting smell to it but as long as it hydrates my skin, that's all that matters. It feels refreshing and makes my skin feel nice and soft overnight!
Love this. Smells amazing so refreshing for the skin. Doesn't leave a sticky weird residue. Love it!

This mask is incredible! I was experiencing super dry skin for the first time in my life during the winter season, and I was so upset that my skin was so cracked and flaky. I used this mask almost every night and saw a noticeable and amazing improvement in my skin.
I'm in love with this mask! It does its job at night moisturizing my skin. In the morning my face feels rested and hydrated. Thank you!
Not only is this my first time trying an overnight mask , the ingredients had me intrigued. This left my face feeling nice and rejuvenated !
